questions.prompt: An attacker runs one command and gets a list of every host name and address in a company's zone.
A victim's network is flooded with large DNS replies to questions it never asked.
For an hour, every customer of one ISP who types `bank.com` lands on a fake site. Their own machines are clean.

questions.prompt: Which defense would have let the ISP's resolver reject the forged `bank.com` answer?

Someone steals the password to a company's domain registrar account and changes its NS records.
Users on café Wi-Fi don't want others on the network to see which sites they look up.
